{{Quote|Organa's got medics by the river for their own men. Someone need to "requisition" their supplies and take them to the border post.|Taith|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Taith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] serving for the [[House of Thul]] military forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He asked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] to retrieve medical supplies from a [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] camp near his position.
